text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby—
On this day, well over a hundred thousand people
had packed into Tokyo Racecourse.
To see the three who came to be known as the 'Big Three'... 'BNW', following last month's Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...From an initial two-horse race, to the Big Three.
Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and
Winning Ticket gather strong support."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Still, taking the initials to make "BNW"...
choice_data_list: It just shows how much attention is on you.
It just shows how much attention is on you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's true that even more press than usual showed up
for last week's open practice. However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, did you hear? About Ticket-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I heard, I heard~. You're turning down
all interviews and fan events right now, right?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-senpai hasn't really been
acting like herself lately, has she?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: If something's bothering you, come talk to me.
If something's worrying you, talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's not even worth consulting over.
Think of it like the feeling right before an exam is handed back."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What was the answer to that question?
I just can't stop wondering about it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, the formula for victory always has a solution.
I will glean the optimal answer from this race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...The sense of unease I felt "at" the Satsuki Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...The sense of unease I've felt "since" the Satsuki Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Is this strange feeling merely accidental?
Or could it be...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo!! Do your best--!!
Go become a Derby Umamusume--!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Leave it to me!!
I'm definitely winning here!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...Should I just focus solely on the match for now?)
